route_text: This tour is designed to introduce and orient you to our website. Please select your exploration route.
Explore our planned and ongoing research projects. Click on any project to read more about it.
Each year, Bodha asks a Big Question about the most fundamental problems and open questions that Hindu society faces today. See this year's and future questions here, and click on any to know more.
Bodha Academy trains scholars in Indic research methodology and anthropology, and runs online courses. See here our list of courses, and current scholars at the Academy.

Bodha Anveshi is our flagship culture tours program, featuring sacred journeys to unexplored kshetras of India, where every outer journey becomes an inner journey. Explore chapters open for registration, see past and future chapters, testimonials, and more.
Our monthly newsletter brings together the many strands of work unfolding at Bodha. View released issues here.
A creative project in cultural storytelling through digital comics, recreating legends, triumphs, struggles, and tragedies from Indian history. New comics every fortnight.
You’ve now seen Bodha’s active work and public projects. Continue into our writings, library, and knowledge systems, or end the tour here.
Read our range of essays, opinion pieces, festivals coverage and more.
Watch our podcasts, conference sessions, and other video appearances.
The Bodha Open Library is a collection of readings in Hindu culture and history, philosophical systems, Indian knowledge systems (IKS), scriptures, and more.
All readings at the Open Library are grouped into helpful categories. Explore them here.
We've curated the texts at Open Library into reading paths - helpful journeys through specific lines of query and curiosity.
A curated list of 1000 books to help discover itihasa, Bharata, and Dharma. Select any of the categories here to see the books curated under it.
The explorer is the easiest way to browse all content at our website, grouped into categories - our own writings, texts at Open Library, research projects, and more.
Think of concepts as supertags - large umbrellas of thematic groupings for all content at our website.

Ontology is a work-in-progress of passion for us - an attempt to map all of our English terminology to the Sanskrit language - to root us to Indic civilizational consciousness. In phase 1, we're mapping it all to the categories of the Amarakosha.
You’ve now seen Bodha’s content ecosystem. Continue to learn about the people, influences, and ways to reach us, or end here.
